address: LP 51  Persad Drive, off Datta Drive, Orangefield Road, Carapichaima
scopeDescription:
1. Site Preparation
• Break up and remove existing concrete to reroute cable to new pole location.
2. Pole Installation
• Dig a 4-foot deep hole for the installation of a 24-foot new pole.
• To supply and install 1 - 24ft. x 5mm electrical pole.
• Plant the new pole and cast a concrete base (approximately 18 inches) to secure the pole.
3. Point of Entrance Cable Installation
• We recommend that the point of entrance cable (cable from the pole to the meter base) be changed as it was noticed to be stripping/peeling.
• To supply and install 7m - 3x50mm² PVC cable.
• Secure cable to the new pole using hose clips.
4. Meter Base Installation
• To supply and install 1 - 200A single-phase meter base with reducer.
5. Cable Rerouting
• Reroute existing cable from the old meter base to the new pole location.
6. Triplex Installation
• Installation of new cable from the T&TEC pole to the house.
7. Inspection and Certification
• Perform a site inspection to ensure all work is completed to standard.
• Obtain an Inspection Certificate to facilitate the issuance of a Completion Certificate.
